source.title: PC端卡片模块层级圆角规则
source.valueAuthority: Figma Radius variable scale plus designer confirmation

L1.usage: 页面级容器、核心内容区或视觉权重最高的大型卡片

L2.usage: 一级卡片内部的功能分区、主要模块或常规业务卡片

L3.usage: 信息分组、小型内容卡片、列表项或局部操作区域

L4.usage: 尺寸较小、层级较深的容器或最小常规元素

hardRules: Treat the concrete design instance as authoritative when its radius differs from the component-set default.
For example, implement an S-size component with 8px radius as 8px when the approved design instance shows 8px; do not force the default 4px.
Do not infer radius from component size name alone when an inspected design instance is available.
Use the approved 4px, 6px, 8px and 12px radius scale for regular UI and card hierarchy; 16px, 24px and 999px are available for specified large or pill-shaped cases.
For dialogs, banners and special components, adjust flexibly according to the approved design requirement.
Keep cards of the same level and function consistent within one page.
Nested-card radius should not exceed the outer-card radius and should normally decrease by at least one level.
Prefer existing radius values before introducing a new value.
flexibleRule: Use the inspected design or component-specific specification for flexible cases; do not mechanically apply card hierarchy.

audit.documentationConflict: The designer confirmed that the Radius variable library is authoritative for defaults.
audit.action: Map the regular card hierarchy to 12px, 8px, 6px and 4px; use 16px, 24px or 999px only for their specified scenarios, and follow an approved design instance for exceptions.
